observed_facts: The user refused or was unable to provide the required authentication details (email or name + zip code) across multiple steps.
The agent correctly followed policy by offering a transfer to a human agent when authentication could not be completed.
The automated run ended due to the user stopping or being transferred.
inference: The task failed because the user refused to provide the necessary authentication information required by the agent policy, making it impossible for the agent to proceed with any order-related actions.
needs_verification: Whether the simulated user behavior of persistently refusing authentication matches the intended test case design or should have accepted an alternative.
